Thanks, Priyom — quick answers:

- Preference: Hosted for initial POC (we want to validate latency/cost quickly). If POC looks good we will likely move to Dedicated for production.
- Region: Data residency needs to be US only; preference for us-east. EU is out for now.
- Procurement: Our procurement window is ~45–60 days for new vendors (SOW + SOC2 review).

We also need to get your security questionnaire back to our InfoSec team and a short SLA note for the POC. I can send the questionnaire later today.

Can you include a column in the MAP that maps each milestone to procurement/tech/legal owners and acceptance criteria?

Quick tech notes:

- Hosted (US-East) is good for a 6-week POC. We can run their load on standard g4d pools with continuous batching; expect median p95 generation latency ~120–160ms depending on model.
- If they plan to move to Dedicated, recommend committing to a 3–6 month reserved pool to get predictable pricing and capacity. We can propose a 20% committed discount for a 6-month commit — confirm with revenue.
- Private: requires VPC prep (network mirror, KMS integration, SOC2 evidence). Should budget an extra 4–6 weeks for infra prep + security verification.

I'll draft suggested SLA language for a POC (99.5% availability, 1-hr P1 response, per-route latency target) and attach to the MAP.
